title: V5: interval-based seal suppression (one strike per nominal window)
brief: CY soak after live-attester fix: seals work but seal_suppression_summary shows ~2200 suppressed / 100s while sealed_in_window ~37. Root cause: spawn_seal_loop calls close_supp on every cluster_gate/lease fail (every 10ms poll), which clears open_slot; next poll open_slot(same deadline) opens a NEW slot → ~100 false suppressions per second during normal ~200ms attest wait. Owner rule: count suppression only when (now - interval_trigger_ms) > nominal_ms without Ok(seal); after recording one suppression, move trigger to now+10ms for paced re-check. Attest RTT < nominal must not accrue penalty points.

root_cause.loop_pattern: open_slot(next_seal) → gate fail → close_supp → sleep(10ms) → open_slot(same next_seal) → slots++ & slot_supp++
root_cause.test_gap: slot_polls_no_inflate keeps slot open across polls; production closes slot each poll

owner_semantics.suppression_definition: From interval_trigger_ms until now elapsed > seal_interval_ms (nominal) and block still not sealed for this grid deadline
owner_semantics.after_record: interval_trigger_ms = now_ms + SEAL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS (10ms) before next suppression evaluation
owner_semantics.not_suppressed: Attest completes in 200–300ms within same nominal second — no strike
owner_semantics.denominator: ~1 slot per grid deadline per 100s (~100 slots), not per poll
owner_semantics.log_noise: After attester connects, gate/propose path still runs every 10ms — rate-limit operator-visible suppress logs; do not log per-poll suppress

state: active_deadline_ms: Option<u64> — current next_seal_time_ms being pursued
interval_trigger_ms: Option<u64> — wall ms when this deadline attempt started
suppression_recorded_for_deadline: bool — at most one strike per deadline until seal or grid skip
API_sketch: begin_deadline_attempt(deadline_ms, now_ms) — if new deadline: slots++, set trigger=now, clear recorded flag
evaluate_suppression(now_ms, nominal_ms) -> bool — if active && now - trigger > nominal && !recorded: slot_supp++, recorded=true, trigger=now+10, return true
on_sealed() — sealed_in++, clear active deadline state
on_grid_skip(old_deadline, new_deadline) — if missed seal across boundary: slot_supp once (SlotSkipped)
SealSuppressWindow_refactor.remove: close_supp on every run_cluster_gate/lease false in hot loop

spawn_seal_loop.gate_fail_path: sleep(poll_pause) only; call evaluate_suppression when appropriate (may be no-op until nominal elapsed)
spawn_seal_loop.lease_fail: same interval rule or fence-specific once-per-deadline — document
spawn_seal_loop.propose_tick: record_cluster_prop_tick only when beginning new deadline attempt or throttled (e.g. once per nominal window), not 100/s — reduces post-connect log noise

run_cluster_gate_logging.optional: sample quorum_pending info 1/s per height while in-wait

emit_suppress_summary.CY_expect: 100s window: slots ~90–110, suppressed ~0–40 (not ~2200), sealed ~35–40, pct aligns with real missed intervals

acceptance_criteria: Unit: 100 gate-fail polls within 200ms of same deadline → 0 suppressions; after nominal+1ms → exactly 1 suppression; trigger advances +10ms
Unit: seal within 300ms of deadline → 0 suppressions, 1 sealed
Integration test or harness: slot_polls matches production loop semantics
CY 5min: seal_suppression_summary suppressed < 80 (order of tens per 100s, not thousands)
CY: no burst of seal_suppressed_by_cluster warn after attester ready (sampled logs OK)
operator_verify: CY steady: grep seal_suppression_summary — slots~100 suppressed~30-50 sealed~37; inter-seal ~1s; no log flood after cluster_attest_ready
